name: clone_voice
description: Creates a voice clone from an audio file. Returns a voice_clone_id that can be polled via GET /v3/voices/{voice_clone_id} until the status is 'complete'. The resulting voice can be used with POST /v3/voices/speech and POST /v3/videos.

audio.description: Audio file for voice cloning. Provide as {type: 'url', url: '...'}, {type: 'asset_id', asset_id: '...'}, or {type: '', media_type: '...', data: '...'}.
audio.title: Audio

voiceName.description: Display name for the cloned voice.
voiceName.title: Voicename

language.description: Language hint for the voice (e.g., 'en', 'es'). Auto-detected if omitted.
language.title: Language

removeBackgroundNoise.description: Remove background noise from the audio before cloning.
removeBackgroundNoise.title: Removebackgroundnoise

AssetId.description: Asset input via HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint.

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint
asset_id.title: Asset Id

AssetUrl.description: Asset input via publicly accessible HTTPS URL.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the asset
